```{r setup, include=FALSE}
valeur = function(x, defaut = "Non renseigne") {
  if (!length(x) || is.na(x[[1]]) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
    return(defaut)
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
texte = function(x) {
  x = valeur(x, "")
  x = gsub("\r\n?", "\n", x)
  x = gsub("\\\\par\\b", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
  if (grepl("<[^>]+>|&[A-Za-z#0-9]+;", x)) {
    x = gsub("(?i)<br\\s*/?>|</(p|div|li)>", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
    x = tryCatch(xml2::xml_text(xml2::read_html(paste0("<div>", x, "</div>"))),
                 error = function(e) gsub("<[^>]+>", "", x))
  }
  lignes = strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lignes = trimws(lignes)
  lignes = lignes[nzchar(lignes)]
  for (symbole in c("\\", "`", "*", "_", "{", "}", "[", "]", "<", ">", "#", "!", "|"))
    lignes = gsub(symbole, paste0("\\", symbole), lignes, fixed = TRUE)
  paste(lignes, collapse = "\n\n")
}
``` 

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("\\gdef\\senateurstitre{", params$titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurssoustitre{", params$sous_titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{\\raisebox{-8pt}{\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{",
    params$logo, "}}}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\pagestyle{senateurs}\n")
```

```{r catalogue, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
d = params$donnees
cat("**Sujet recherche :** ", texte(params$sous_titre), "\n\n",
    nrow(d), " dossier(s) trouve(s).\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(d)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    titre = texte(d$titre[[i]])
    if (!nzchar(titre)) titre = "Titre non renseigne"
    cat("\n\n### ", i, ". ", titre, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Date :** ", texte(d$date[[i]]),
        "  \n**Identifiant :** ", texte(d$uid[[i]]),
        "  \n**Legislature :** ", texte(d$legislature[[i]]),
        "  \n**Procedure :** ", texte(d$procedure[[i]]),
        "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
} else cat("Aucun dossier correspondant dans la base locale.\n")
```
